strings.zh: 尊敬的客人,欢迎乘坐圣安努号游轮！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Dear passengers, welcome aboard the{NEWLINE}S.S. Anne!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 客人您有事吗？{NEWLINE}今天不出航！
strings.en: Can I help you? We’re not sailing today!

strings.zh: 您好,欢迎乘坐新圣安努号游轮。{NEWLINE}请问您想的目的地是？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello, and welcome aboard the new{NEWLINE}S.S. Anne. Where would you like to go?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 真是抱歉,{NEWLINE}现在开往城都地区的航线还未恢复,{CLEAR}所以暂时去不了浅葱市。
strings.en: We’re very sorry. The route to Johto{NEWLINE}hasn’t reopened yet, so we can’t go to{CLEAR}Olivine City for now.

strings.zh: 好的,目的地水都群岛,请您登船！
strings.en: Very well. Destination: the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands. Please board!

strings.zh: 好的,目的地浅葱市,请您登船！
strings.en: Very well. Destination: Olivine City.{NEWLINE}Please board!
